svg.aria-label: AnonTestLab overview in four stages. 1 Configure: one YAML file, mode tor_like or custom, run with atl run. 2 Run a live network: real relay processes on one machine, a session split over two legs that rejoin at a common exit, with configurable split policy, mixing, traffic, crypto and link conditions; the adversary watches the entry and the merged exit. 3 Attack: correlation_suite, global_observer, watermark, hop_depth and path_compromise. 4 Keep results: measured latency, delivery, bandwidth and leg shares, attack scores, and a results folder. atl compare, sweep, paired, predict, fidelity and dashboard close the loop.
